next.reason: 1985: no item in the RENAMES range, data-name-2 and data-name-3 included, 'can be variable occurrence data items.' 2023 §2023:13.18.45.3 SR8: none of the items in the range shall be 'a variable-length data item, or an occurs-depending table'. The other items in that rule (object, message-tag, pointer, strongly-typed) are post-1985 features, so the same 1985 programs are refused.
